_comment: Mutable state for yairpg-analysis. Edit via the skill's commands, not by hand where a command exists.

station.name: Swampland tribe
station._note: ASSUMPTION[A4]. Update with: run.js station <location name>. Tiers are re-read from src/locations.js when the name matches a location with a crafting block.

anchors.note: No quality tag, so no rarity term. recipe_level[1]=25 and 25 < 29 < 31, so the taper is ACTIVE but not floored - this isolates the XP reduction curve. Must pass before anchor 2 runs.

Has a quality tag. Runs ONLY after anchor 1 passes, so the reduction curve is already known-good and any mismatch here isolates to the rarity term. Rarity is pinned at 1.1 (uncommon) rather than read from a live roll; the in-game display showed 46.4-54.9 across uncommon-rare at Crafting 27.

damage_anchor._note: ASSUMPTION[A7]. Static derivation of attack_power walks race -> level -> equipment -> skills -> effects and is the most error-prone number this skill produces. Read 'Attack power' off the character sheet and record it with: run.js damage-anchor <value>. Until then OHK verdicts print as INDICATIVE, not verified.

play_state._note: ASSUMPTION[A6]. User-stated play style, not derivable from save or source. one_hit_kill is CHECKED by the damage module when a damage anchor exists.

Red ant swarm.what: The only enemy in the game that drops a normally-gatherable item: Oneberry/Golmoon leaf/Belmart leaf (0.005 chance each, usually Herbalism) and Wood log (0.002, usually Woodcutting) - enemies.js:381-395.
Red ant swarm.why_it_matters: tags are ["living","insect"] - NOT "beast" - so its drops never get the Butchering multiplier the way Bear/Frog/etc. do (analysis.js:141 already gates correctly on the beast tag; this is a documentation note, not a code fix). Its drop chances are also far below the matching gathering-activity rate, so baseCosts()'s cheapest-source pick should essentially never prefer it over gathering - if a future run ever shows Red ant swarm as the cheapest source for one of these 4 items, that is a red flag worth checking by hand before trusting the number.
Red ant swarm._note: Logged 2026-09-06 in place of adding a general drop-vs-gathering 'kind' field to the cost model - it's the only known case, so a plain note here covers it for near-zero cost. Revisit if a second such exception ever turns up.
